365:t_1:86.en:
$$デュオ$$
「I'd like to see how long you can keep saying that.」

365:t_1:87.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「Yeah. Sounds like it's a matter of the constitution you were born with.」

365:t_1:88.en:
$$アレルヤ$$
「In $$クロウ$$'s case, a constitution for shouldering debt gets added on top of that.」

365:t_1:89.en:
$$クロウ$$
「You... You're as hard on me as ever...」

365:t_1:92.en:
$$コンロイ$$
「For the infiltration we'll use $$オーガス$$, which handles well in tight quarters. And to locate our rescue target, $$オルソン・Ｄ・ヴェルヌ$$, we'll have $$桂$$, who shares that trait, take the lead.」

365:t_1:93.en:
$$桂$$
「Once we get close, we have the $$特異点$$ sensor Dr. $$トライア$$ prepared. With it we can pinpoint where $$オルソン$$ is.」

365:t_1:94.en:
$$桂$$
(To think she prepared something like this... Maybe the doctor felt, somewhere inside, that $$オルソン$$ had to be saved too...)

365:t_1:95.en:
$$コンロイ$$
「$$桂$$'s escort will be $$スザク$$, $$アレルヤ$$, and $$クロウ$$...」

365:t_1:97.en:
$$コンロイ$$
「Diversion in the surrounding area: $$竜馬$$, $$刹那$$, $$タケル$$, $$万丈$$, and $$シモン$$.」

365:t_1:98.en:
$$竜馬$$
「I'll raise hell in a big way.」

365:t_1:99.en:
$$コンロイ$$
「Containment outside the facility will be handled by the Sniper Team, $$プリベンター$$, $$エレメント$$, $$キリコ$$, and $$エコーズ$$.」

365:t_1:101.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「Also, as special decoy personnel, we need $l and Miss $$スズネ$$ to move as well. The $$ＳＲＴ$$ will be their escort.」

365:t_1:102.en:
$n
「Understood. I'll judge the timing for summoning $$ジェニオン$$ on the scene.」

365:t_1:103.en:
$$コンロイ$$
「In three hours, the $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$ will move out. During that diversion, the $$クォーター$$ will enter the atmosphere.」

365:t_1:104.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「This operation is the first step of our counteroffensive against the $$サイデリアル$$... $$オペレーション・エクリプス$$.」

365:t_1:105.en:
$$タケル$$
「Eclipse... It means a solar eclipse, right?」

365:t_1:106.en:
$$万丈$$
「$$サイデリアル$$ means fixed stars... But we can't let them raise their sun on high.」

365:t_1:107.en:
$$コンロイ$$
「This mission... We will make it a success, no matter what.」

365:t_1:111.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Want to have $$ラルク$$ take over the decoy job?」

365:t_1:112.en:
$$スズネ$$
「No... I'll do it. $n is going too, after all.」

365:t_1:113.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「...There's still time before the operation begins. Use it to calm yourself.」

365:t_1:115.en:
$$クルツ$$
「$n... Since you're her partner, I'm leaving Miss $$スズネ$$'s care to you.」

365:t_1:116.en:
$$マオ$$
「See you, Miss $$スズネ$$. Let's pull this off and go have some good beer.」

365:t_1:119.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Right now, not feeling anxious is what makes me anxious...」

365:t_1:121.en:
$$スズネ$$
「...Ever since we broke out of the $$時の牢獄$$, the anxiety inside me kept growing bigger and bigger.」

365:t_1:122.en:
$$スズネ$$
「And as if in response to it, the world fell into crisis...」

365:t_1:124.en:
$$スズネ$$
「But I wasn't scared... Because $n was feeling anxious just like me, and fighting alongside me anyway.」

365:t_1:125.en:
$$スズネ$$
「...And yet now, I don't feel anxious...」

365:t_1:126.en:
$n
「That's... because Miss $$スズネ$$'s heart has grown stronger...」

365:t_1:127.en:
$$スズネ$$
「At first, I thought so too... No, I made myself think so...」

365:t_1:128.en:
$$スズネ$$
「But that's not it... I'm... afraid of who I am now...」

365:t_1:129.en:
$$スズネ$$
「I feel like I'm gradually ceasing to be myself...」

365:t_1:131.en:
$$スズネ$$
「...I'm sorry. Talking about this before an operation...」

365:t_1:132.en:
$n
「...Um... I'm not good with words, but... I think Miss $$スズネ$$ is Miss $$スズネ$$.」

365:t_1:133.en:
$n
「Even if you get down, or snap at people sometimes, or turn black-hearted, Miss $$スズネ$$ is still Miss $$スズネ$$.」

365:t_1:135.en:
$n
「Ah, damn... I wish I could put it into better words...」

365:t_1:136.en:
$$スズネ$$
「That's enough. I got the message.」

365:t_1:137.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Besides, I'm all right now... Talking about what's been on my mind all this time cleared my head.」

365:t_1:139.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Really. There's no point in lying to you, $n.」

365:t_1:140.en:
$n
「...Then it's fine. Let's do our best.」

365:t_1:142.en:
$$スズネ$$
(I don't know how long this feeling will last...)

365:t_1:143.en:
$$スズネ$$
(Someday, I'm sure... I won't be able to fight alongside $n anymore... I have that feeling...)

365:t_1:144.en:
$$スズネ$$
(But I'm sure... $n could do it... even without me...)

365:t_2:5.en:
$$セツコ$$
「I've had the minimum training as an infantry soldier too. I have no intention of holding you all back.」

365:t_2:6.en:
$$マオ$$
「That's not what I mean. I'm talking about $$バルビエル$$.」

365:t_2:7.en:
$$クルツ$$
「I heard it from $$クロウ$$. That guy's fixated on you.」

365:t_2:8.en:
$$セツコ$$
「...I've begun to understand a little about him and me.」

365:t_2:9.en:
$n
「Is that why you volunteered for the infiltration team at the last minute, $$セツコ$$?」

365:t_2:11.en:
$$セツコ$$
「I think $$バルビエル$$ and I are probably in the same kind of relationship as $$ストラウス$$ and $$ランド$$.」

365:t_2:13.en:
$$セツコ$$
「So I think... $$バルビエル$$ is trying to manipulate me to suit his will...」

365:t_2:14.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「Did you volunteer so you could defeat him with your own hands?」

365:t_2:16.en:
$n
(...$$セツコ$$ is lying... I sense something else entirely from her...)

365:t_2:19.en:
$$マオ$$
「$n! You take $$セツコ$$ and Miss $$スズネ$$ and move on ahead!」

365:t_2:20.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「$$桂木$$, $$流$$ and the others will probably be spotted before long, too!」

365:t_2:21.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「When the commotion reaches its peak, summon $$ジェニオン$$ and throw the enemy into confusion!」

365:t_2:23.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Miss $$スズネ$$, we're moving out!」
